name: fz522_curse_phantom_force
purpose: A Ghost Curse into Phantom Force (issue 522): Golurk, p1a, uses Curse on Polteageist, p2a, after Polteageist has prepared Phantom Force (step 2). The Invulnerability step comes before the TryHit and the onHit (sim/battle-actions.ts:556): the move line carries [miss], a -miss follows, and there is no HP cost and no curse. A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_2_99), cut after its step 2: adopted as a regression fixture. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
